insights.title: Massive Volume Ramp — 3,573 New Sends This Period
insights.detail: Total executions grew from 1,696 (baseline) to 5,269 (+211%). 3,267 members actively in-flight across 4 sequences.

insights.title: First Engagement Signals — 3 Replies, 675 Opens
insights.detail: Baseline showed zero. Sissy Outdoor Furniture leads with 27.33% open rate. P+P Team Outdoor Living delivered 2 of 3 replies.

insights.title: SMS Channel Performing: 99.91% Delivery on 2,272 Sends
insights.detail: The Existing Customers SMS step delivered 2,272 of 2,274 messages — only 2 failures. This is the highest-volume step in the account and it is delivering near-perfectly. Great channel health. Note: SMS delivery is visible at the step level but not yet available in aggregate platform metrics.

insights.title: Anonymous Visitors: 20.33% Bounce Rate — Expected for This List Type
insights.detail: Anonymous visitor data is inherently noisy (IP→company matching, email guessing, bot traffic). At 143 members and 61 bounces, it is a tiny list where every bad record stings visually. The 14.33% open rate and 0.67% click rate on what did land are solid for this channel. Within expected range given data provider limitations.

insights.title: Bounce Rate Improved: 18.51% → 7.34%
insights.detail: Existing Customers (0.42% bounce rate on 2,650 sends) is pulling the average way down.

insights.title: Open/Click Tracking Now Active
insights.detail: Baseline had no tracking. Now 675 opens + 31 clicks visible. UTM tracking has also been added to all sequence links for attribution.

insights.title: No Bookings — Expected for Retail Model
insights.detail: Conversion is walk-in/phone/website. Track store visits and UTMs instead.

nextSteps.action: Launch Out-of-State Buyer Campaign — Georgia Sales Tax Angle
nextSteps.detail: Build a new sequence targeting out-of-state buyers (e.g., Georgia residents). Angle: no sales tax on purchases at Porch + Patio. Proven conversion lever for border-state retailers — distinct offer local competitors can't match.
27.33% OR with 927 queued. Increase send limits and expand intent signal feeds.

nextSteps.action: Audit Current Audiences & Intent Signal Feeds
nextSteps.detail: Review all 4 existing audiences for quality, overlap, and freshness. The Outdoor Furniture and Outdoor Living intent sequences have 1,334 members still queued — ensure intent signal sources are actively populating with quality data.
675 people opened emails. UTMs are now on all links for website tracking. Add a 'Mention this email for 10% off' in-store promo to close the walk-in attribution loop.

With 99.91% delivery confirmed on the Existing Customers sequence, consider adding SMS touchpoints to the Outdoor Furniture and Outdoor Living sequences to boost engagement where email open rates taper off in later steps.
